description: Save or rename a contact, like WhatsApp's Edit contact screen. saveOnPhone also saves the number to the phone's address book. WhatsApp does not let linked devices set a birthday.

chat.description: Exact WhatsApp chat JID from list_chats, or a phone number with country code
